- [Start preview chat](https://docs.typebot.com/api-reference/chat/start-preview-chat.md): Use this endpoint to test your bot. The answers will not be saved. And some blocks like "Send email" will be skipped.
- [Update typebot in session](https://docs.typebot.com/api-reference/chat/update-typebot-in-session.md): Update chat session with latest typebot modifications. This is useful when you want to update the typebot in an ongoing session after making changes to it.
